subject.title: Feature/Fix: Integrate lineage discovery and shadow accounting

question: Should this intermediate shadow-integration slice land independently after its prerequisite, or only as part of the reviewed four-PR stack once exact-head latency proof and the safety and validation follow-ups are ready?
rationale: The code appears internally coherent, but accepting an intermediate synchronous shadow scan and coordinating the stack landing order are repository-risk choices that tests alone cannot resolve.

options.title: Land as a coordinated stack
options.body: Review and merge the prerequisite first, require exact-head cold and warm runtime evidence, then land this slice with the safety and validation follow-ups in order.

options.title: Allow the intermediate shadow slice
options.body: Merge after the prerequisite while explicitly accepting additional changed-scan work and relying on legacy output authority until later stack PRs land.

options.title: Prefer the narrower fix
options.body: Pause this stack and evaluate https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2118 as the lower-scope near-term correction for the canonical overcount issue.

recommendation.title: Land as a coordinated stack
recommendation.body: Review and merge the prerequisite first, require exact-head cold and warm runtime evidence, then land this slice with the safety and validation follow-ups in order.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership and release and merge responsibility make this the best available owner for the stack-level risk decision.
